completeness.why: The four ternary sites now pass their raw value to the existing exported getScheduledAmount, which covers missing, numeric and ranged amounts. The template site calls it with an explicit rounding mode for its preserved halve-the-rounded-sum inconsistency, but still selects that mode with its own op === 'isbetween' dispatch, a local condition the shared function's type dispatch already covers; scored partial as the lower level.

interface.why: Reuses the existing helper and adds one named rounding parameter ('nearest' | 'sum') that makes the preserved template inconsistency explicit, and widens the type to the null it already handled; the template's op-based choice of the mode and the terse 'sum' name are the only blemishes.

disguised_duplication.where: All five inline calculations are removed in favour of getScheduledAmount; nothing is left reshaped at the sites.
